```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)

# Get all unique dates
dates <- unique(biovolume_nbss$Date)

# Lists to store plots and regression tables
plots <- list()
regression_tables <- list()

for (d in dates) {
  d_str <- format(as.Date(d), "%Y-%m-%d")
  
  # Subset for this date and Tow == 200
  samples_nbss <- biovolume_nbss %>%
    filter(Tow == "200", Date == d)
  
  # Compute NBSS
  data4 <- NBSS(samples_nbss, N = TRUE)
  
  # Only keep "straight line" part
  samples_straight_esd <- data4 %>%
    filter(Spectra > 1e-01, Spectra < 1e+01, !is.na(Spectra), !is.na(NBSS))
  
  # Skip if no data
 # if(nrow(samples_straight_esd) == 0) next
  
  # Fit linear model NBSS ~ log10(Spectra)
  model <- lm(NBSS ~ log10(Spectra), data = samples_straight_esd)
  
  # Extract coefficients and model stats
  tidied <- tidy(model)
  glanced <- glance(model)
  
  regression_tables[[d_str]] <- data.frame(
    Date = d_str,
    intercept = tidied$estimate[tidied$term == "(Intercept)"],
    slope = tidied$estimate[tidied$term == "log10(Spectra)"],
    slope_p_value = tidied$p.value[tidied$term == "log10(Spectra)"],
    adj_r_squared = glanced$adj.r.squared
  )
  
  # Plot
  min_mesh4 <- min(data4$Spectra, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_mesh4 <- max(data4$Spectra, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  p <- ggplot(samples_straight_esd, aes(x = Spectra, y = NBSS)) +
    geom_point(data = data4, aes(x = Spectra, y = NBSS), color = "black") +
    geom_point(color = "red") +
    scale_x_log10(limits = c(min_mesh4, max_mesh4)) +
    labs(
      x = "Equivalent Spherical Diameter [µm]",
      y = "NBSS log[mL/m³/mm³]",
      title = paste("NBSS – Date:", d_str)
    )
  
  plots[[d_str]] <- p
  print(p)
}

# Combine all regression tables into a single dataframe
nbss_regression_summary <- bind_rows(regression_tables)

# View the final regression table
print(nbss_regression_summary)

#check histogram of slope vlaues
nbss_slopes_hist <- ggplot(nbss_regression_summary, aes(x = slope)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "grey70", color = "black") +
  labs(
    x = "NBSS slope",
    y = "Count",
    title = "Distribution of NBSS slopes"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#print(nbss_slopes_hist) #normally distributed
```

```{r slopes by date}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Make sure Date is in Date format
nbss_regression_summary <- nbss_regression_summary %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))

# Fit linear model: slope ~ Date
slope_lm <- lm(slope ~ Date, data = nbss_regression_summary)

# Create a dataframe of predicted values for plotting
predicted <- nbss_regression_summary %>%
  mutate(predicted_slope = predict(slope_lm, newdata = nbss_regression_summary))

# Scatter plot with linear model line
slope_plot <- ggplot(nbss_regression_summary, aes(x = Date, y = slope)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = predicted, aes(x = Date, y = predicted_slope), color = "red", size = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "NBSS Slope",
    title = "Temporal Trend of NBSS Slopes with Linear Fit"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Print the plot
print(slope_plot) 


# Optional: view regression summary
summary(slope_lm)
plot(slope_lm)
ggsave("slope_plot.png", plot = slope_plot, dpi = 300)
browseURL("slope_plot.png")
```

```{r slopes by secchi depth}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
nbss_regression_summary_env <- merge(
  pca_data_df, 
  nbss_regression_summary,
  by = "Date",
  all = TRUE  # use all=TRUE for a full outer join, or all=FALSE for inner join
)

nbss_regression_summary_env <- nbss_regression_summary_env %>% mutate(Year = year(Date), 
         Month = month(Date), 
         Season = case_when(
      Month %in% 1:3 ~ "Winter",
      Month %in% 4:6 ~ "Spring",
      Month %in% 7:9 ~ "Summer",
      Month %in% 10:12 ~ "Fall"))

#nbss_regression_summary_env <- na.omit(nbss_regression_summary_env) 
# Fit linear model: slope ~ Date
slope_lm_secchi <- lm(slope ~ sqrt(Secchi.depth), data = nbss_regression_summary_env)

# Create a dataframe of predicted values for plotting
predicted_secchi <- nbss_regression_summary_env %>%
  mutate(predicted_slope = predict(slope_lm_secchi, newdata = nbss_regression_summary_env))

# Scatter plot with linear model line
slope_plot_secchi <- ggplot(nbss_regression_summary_env, aes(x = sqrt(Secchi.depth), y = slope)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkgrey", size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = predicted_secchi, aes(x = sqrt(Secchi.depth), y = predicted_slope), color = "black", size = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Square Root Transformed Secchi Depth (m)",
    y = "NBSS Slope",
    title = "Temporal Trend of NBSS Slopes with Linear Fit"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Print the plot
print(slope_plot_secchi)

# Optional: view regression summary
summary(slope_lm_secchi)
ggsave("slope_plot_secchi.png", plot = slope_plot_secchi, dpi = 300)
browseURL("slope_plot_secchi.png")

##======CLEANED UP AND ADDED 95% CI BASED ON PREDICATED NBSS SLOPE AT EACH SECCHI POINT=====

# Create prediction grid (smooth line + CI)
predicted_secchi_2 <- data.frame(
  Secchi.depth = seq(
    min(nbss_regression_summary_env$Secchi.depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(nbss_regression_summary_env$Secchi.depth, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  )
)
print(predicted_secchi_2)
# Get fitted values + confidence intervals
predicted_ci <- predict(
  slope_lm_secchi,
  newdata = predicted_secchi_2,
  interval = "confidence"
)

# Bind predictions to dataframe (names: fit, lwr, upr)
predicted_secchi_2 <- cbind(predicted_secchi_2, predicted_ci)

slope_plot_secchi_2 <- ggplot(
  nbss_regression_summary_env,
  aes(x = sqrt(Secchi.depth), y = slope)
) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +

  # Confidence interval ribbon
  geom_ribbon(
    data = predicted_secchi_2,
    aes(
      x = sqrt(Secchi.depth),
      ymin = lwr,
      ymax = upr
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey70",
    alpha = 0.35
  ) +

  # Fitted line
  geom_line(
    data = predicted_secchi_2,
    aes(
      x = sqrt(Secchi.depth),
      y = fit
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 4)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2.0, NA)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Square Root Transformed Secchi Depth (m)",
    y = "NBSS Slope",
    title = NULL
  ) +

  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),  # extra belt-and-suspenders
    plot.background  = element_blank(),  # ensures full blank background
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text  = element_text(color = "black")
  )

print(slope_plot_secchi_2)

ggsave("slope_plot_secchi_2.png", plot = slope_plot_secchi_2, dpi = 300)
browseURL("slope_plot_secchi_2.png")
```
